pr.t: Gefiederte Nachbarn - Die bunte Welt der Gartenvögel
pr.d: Geheime Dramen, raffinierte Überlebensstrategien und starke Persönlichkeiten zeigen sich unter den Vögeln in der täuschend idyllischen Kulisse eines Gartens in Klagenfurt. Durch die Jahreszeiten wetteifern Singvögel miteinander um Nahrungsquellen.

Turmfalken sind die erfolgreichsten Greifvögel Europas. Sie sind anpassungsfähige Bewohner von Au-Gebieten ebenso wie von alpinen Regionen. Außerdem sind sie wahrlich meisterhafte Jäger. Die Dokumentation begleitet zwei Brutpaare.

Im Märchen treten Frösche immer in denselben Rollen auf. In Wirklichkeit ist die Amphibienwelt aber um einiges vielfältiger. Zu dieser Welt zählen der tödliche Pfeilgiftfrosch und der Darwinfrosch, der mit verblüffenden Methoden für Nachwuchs sorgt. Der Film lädt ein zu einer Entdeckungsreise in die verborgene Welt der Amphibien und zeigt diese oft verkannten Tiere und ihre faszinierende Lebensweise in ihrer ganzen Bandbreite.

Die Libelle, auch Wasserjungfer genannt, bewohnt die Erde schon seit dem Zeitalter der Dinosaurier. Das Insekt lebt vorzugsweise in wasserreichen Gegenden. Doch sein Lebensraum schrumpft, und so sind allein in Europa heute etwa 80 Libellenarten akut vom Aussterben bedroht. Die Dokumentation macht mit Entwicklung und Lebensweise dieses in metallischen Farben leuchtenden Räubers bekannt.

pr.t: Im Reich von Kreuzotter & Co. - Österreichs Schlangen hautnah
pr.d: Schlangenangst ist sehr tief in jedem Menschen verankert. Ein Jahr lang hat man sich diesen Tieren "hautnah" angenähert und ist den Schlangen Österreichs auf der Spur. Es werden sechs verschiedene Schlangenarten vorgestellt.

Carrying on late wildlife conservationist Steve Irwin's mission to bring people closer to animals is now the mission of his family. Terri, Bindi and Robert Irwin return to Animal Planet, giving viewers access to their wildlife adventures around the world and the amazing animals that continue to inspire their conservation efforts. The series features the family caring for more than 1,200 animals at the Australia Zoo; overseeing a world-class wildlife hospital, the largest of its kind in the world; and conducting high-level global expeditions.

Anthony Archer-Wills is the Pete Nelson of pool design. Nelson stars in Animal Planet's popular `Treehouse Masters', creating hideaways in the limbs of oaks and maples. Archer-Wills works on the ground as a world-renowned builder of swimming pools but uses the same creativity and respect for ecology. In `The Pool Master', the charming Brit has unfaltering enthusiasm for his work - rivaled only by his love of a cool gin and tonic. He designs and executes unique and stunning pools that seem to be formed by nature. His goal is "to support the environment, provide homes to beds of aquatic plants, and foster elements of mystery," which enhance the experience of swimming.

People who know and work with Pete Nelson describe him as a tree whisperer. For his part, Nelson lets the trees do the talking. He's a world-renowned treehouse designer and builder, and this series documents the work he and his team of craftsmen - including his son Charlie - do to create incredible homes and businesses in nature's canopy. Pete uses a combination of science and art to realize clients' sky-high aspirations of magnificent multibedroom treehouses with elaborate kitchens and bathrooms, or simpler, peaceful one-room escapes. Die Sendung geht den Fragen auf den Grund, ob es Gott gibt und ob man Gott erfahren kann. Erzählt werden spannende, berührende und unglaubliche Geschichten von Menschen, deren Leben durch eine Begegnung mit Gott auf den Kopf gestellt wurde.

In dieser Folge wird am Herd ein festlicher Hackbraten mit Kirschsauce zubereitet. Das klingt im ersten Moment vielleicht etwas seltsam, aber Kirschen in der Bratensoße sind sehr lecker. Die Kirschen geben eine zusätzliche fruchtige Note.

Die Oma weiß am besten, was zum Kaffee schmeckt. In dieser Sendung lernt man nicht nur, wie man einen echten Zwetschgendatschi mit selbstgemachten Streuseln macht, sondern auch welcher Kaffee am besten dazu passt, um alles Gästen zu servieren.
Gezeigt werden die "Kraftvoll Leben"-Gottesdienste, die zu einem Leben mit Gott einladen.
Die Dokumentationsreihe stellt ferne Länder und kulinarische Köstlichkeiten vor.
Der Pastor Christian Heim teilt jede Woche eine Predigt zu aktuellen geistlichen Themen.

Seit circa 135 Jahren pilgern Juden aus der ganzen Welt nach Israel. Inzwischen lebt knapp die Hälfte der jüdischen Weltbevölkerung dort. Gezeigt wird das moderne Israel in Verbindung mit biblischen Wurzeln und jüdischen Traditionen.

Die amerikanische Bibellehrerin Joyce Meyer nimmt kein Blatt vor den Mund. Humorvoll und direkt spricht sie die Herausforderungen an, die Menschen heutzutage im Alltag begegnen. Sie bietet praktische Lebenshilfe, die auf der Bibel basiert.
In der Sendung berichten Menschen von ihren persönlichen Begegnungen mit Gott im Alltag.
Die Sendung zeigt Predigten von dem früher drogen- und alkoholabhängigen Pastor Bayless Conley.
Joseph Prince ist Prediger der New Creation Church in Singapur. Diese ist eine der bedeutendsten freien christlichen Gemeinden in Asien.
David Hathaway predigt seit über 70 Jahren das Evangelium in ganz Russland, Europa und Israel.
In dieser Ausgabe der Sendung wird ein Zanderfilet auf Winterspargelbett zubereitet.
In der Predigt von Volkhard Spitzer ist der Himmel nicht leer und Gott nur ein Gebet weit entfernt.

Gordon visits family-owned restaurant Sam's Mediterranean Kabob Room in Monrovia, California. pr.t: Lawless Britain? Undercover on the Streets: Dispatches
pr.d: Official crime figures indicate violent crime is falling. So why do so many people feel less safe than ever? Ellie Flynn goes undercover to explore the anti-social behaviour plaguing communities nationwide.

Some extra brunch as Tim Lovejoy and Simon Rimmer host the food and chat show.

Presenters Tim Lovejoy and Simon Rimmer mix a cookery show with a chat show, and the result is `Sunday Brunch.' Each installment finds Simon and Tim cooking in the kitchen, accompanied by that week's celebrity guests. Other segments include interviews and highlights from television and film, an expert who assists with drink tasting, a round-up of what is trendy, and the ever-popular `Sunday Brunch Playlist,' which consists of music videos chosen by the presenters and their guests. Guests have included Stacey Solomon, Lisa Faulkner, Tara Reid, Rufus Wainwright and Marina Diamandis.

Separation Anxiety: Deacon's upset when Kelly goes on a date.

Say Uncle: When Ray realises that his kids would rather spend time with their Uncle Robert than with him, he decides to do something about it.
Moons Over Seattle: Niles finally convinces Daphne's father in England to return to her mother in Seattle.
The Ring Cycle: Niles and Daphne marry on an impulse while on holiday in Reno but are forced to hide their good news when they return to Seattle.
Enemy at the Gate: Frasier and Niles are pitted against the owner of a local garage in a war over principles and two dollars. Daphne leaves the Crane household for the last time.
Proxy Prexy: Frasier's attempts to become condominium president take a new turn when he persuades Martin to run as a 'puppet' candidate.

There's delicate demolition at Jonas and Ulrike's village, as a dilapidated church organ gets a makeover. And strict Brexit rules threaten to derail Kate's Bulgarian dream.

But the former CNBC anchor won't worry about ratings for her hourlong general news program, comparing that burden to "death." "I want people to say that our show is smart. I want our show to be authentic", Burnett says in a promo. "I want our show to have courage". Left unsaid, of course, is that she wants her show to have a big audience, too.

Lisa's Belly: Bart and Lisa have to take steroids after getting an infection at a waterpark - and the new drugs have some alarming side effects, particularly for Lisa.
Portrait of a Lackey on Fire: Smithers tires of Mr Burns' indifference and finds solace in the arms of affectionate fashion designer Michael de Graaf.
Mothers and Other Strangers: Homer does therapy to cope with missing his mother, sending him on a trip down memory lane, to when he and Grampa went on a road trip to find her.
A Made Maggie: Marge sends Homer to find a godfather for an as-yet-unbaptised Maggie. And who'd make a better godfather than mafia don Fat Tony?
I Lost on Jeopardy!: Erica applies to be on TV quiz show Jeopardy! A new crush makes Barry realise that he might not be quite over Lainey yet.
Mom Trumps Willow: Adam decides to see the movie Willow instead of spending Mother's Day with Beverly. Barry is tired of being the middle child.
The Escape: Haley meets Arvin's parents, but when things don't go as planned, fate leads to an unexpected reunion with all her ex-boyfriends.
Clash of Swords: Mitchell and fanboy Phil sneak out to Hero-Con in Clash of Swords cosplay. Gloria's dinosaur party for Joe is ruined.
I Love a Parade: The Pritchett-Dunphy-Tucker clan set off more than a few fireworks at the Fourth of July parade, where Jay's the grand marshal.
Kiss and Tell: Haley asks Mitch and Cam for advice about whether she should tell Arvin about her kiss with Dylan. And Gloria suspects that Manny's Canadian girlfriend isn't real.
From Russia Without Love: Bart orders a Russian bride for Moe. She turns Moe's life around, and he falls in love.
Daddicus Finch: Lisa reads To Kill a Mockingbird and begins to observe wonderful similarities between Homer and Atticus Finch.
Werking Mom: Marge becomes a successful Tupperware salesperson and Lisa tries to do secret good deeds for people.
Krusty the Clown: Homer becomes a TV critic. Krusty joins the circus.
Worst Episode Ever: Bart and Milhouse end up running Comic Book Guy's shop after he has a heart attack. And, while he recovers, Comic Book Guy falls in love...
Brand new series - The Deli: When the local deli is forced to close to make way for a trendy smoothie place, Melissa, Barbara and Jacob fight back against gentrification.
That's No Lady, That's My Cousin: Vivian and Phil reveal their pregnancy news to Will, Carlton, Hilary and Ashley. And Ashley transforms her image to attract boys at school.
Hilary Gets a Job: A lecherous producer hires Hilary as his new weather presenter, but Will interrupts her first broadcast.
What do Britain's sharpest armchair critics think of Slow Horses, Dating Naked, Celebrity Race Across the World and more?
Roll-neck-phobe Lucy returns, and this time men are off the menu. Can Dr Nick cure GP Emma's dating dry patch? And will James's love of 1D send Mark in the direction of the door?
...Experiment: Curious couples sex-periment with opening up their relationships. Connor and Kirstie explore having a threesome. Chanice and Richardo face an unexpected issue.

The three chefs begin by cooking their starters for a surprise veteran of the competition. Chris' dish `Brixton Academy Through the Years' is his refined take on the classic lamb, post-gig junk food he ate after nights out at Brixton Academy.

Chris is cooking his interpretation of the classic beef dish Tournedos Rossini using guinea fowl. His inspiration is Proms in the Park and the British artists who mix classical and modern music styles. Alex's dish commemorates his late brother and the song by Northern Ireland artist Donna Taggart that he associates with the difficult time of his death.

The two remaining chefs from Northern Ireland recreate their four-course menu for the esteemed judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver. There is also a guest judge: rapper Loyle Carner.

The chefs battle to get their starter course to the Abbey Road banquet and don't disappoint with dishes dedicated to everything from Tom Jones to grime. The rivals are cooking to impress Matthew Fort, Oliver Peyton, and Andi Oliver.

Some of the finest chefs in the UK compete to cook a fish course worthy of serving at a banquet celebrating the brilliance of British popular music, held at Abbey Road Studios. Along with the show's panel of expert judges, the rivals need to impress guest judge Kanya King.

The eight regional champions will compete to get their main courses onto the final menu of the banquet at Abbey Road Studios. They will be cooking for the judges' food critic, Matthew Fort, cook and broadcaster Andi Oliver and restaurateur, Oliver Peyton plus guest judge, former Wham! star, Andrew Ridgeley. As ever, the judges will be looking for dishes laced with star quality and a good sprinkling of rock and roll wow factor worthy of a banquet full of the music industry's finest.

Some of the country's finest chefs compete over the final place cooking at a banquet celebrating the brilliance of British popular music, held at Abbey Road studios. Each rival will need to cook a dessert to impress a panel of expert judges, along with guest judge Peter Hook, Joy Division and New Order bassist, and pioneer of Britain's Madchester scene.

After the fall of Jerusalem in 70 AD, legend tells that roughly a thousand politicised Jews made their last stand at Masada, a Herodian palace in the desert. Archaeological evidence proves the tale to be real but also raises more questions than it can answer.

How did the Phoenician princess Jezebel become one of the Bible's most famous femme fatales? Plus how the prophet Elijah's dispute with Jezebel led to a battle on Mount Carmel that involved hundreds of priests, a couple of thunderbolts and one very unfortunate bull.
Jews, Christians and Muslims alike regard the Temple Mount as a very sacred site. Their competing claims make it one of the most dangerous areas in the Middle East.

The Bible says it was Joshua who conquered Canaan, the land God promised to the Israelites, but did the Old Testament's fiercest warrior even exist? It's hard to find any trace of Joshua today: his specialty, after all, was destroying temples and cities, not building them.

The triumphs of the Prime Minister who led England through its darkest hour and on to victory.
King George V's death in 1936 was later revealed to have been hastened by his physician. What were his motives and did he also euthanise the King's sister?
Sordid speculation dogged the life of Prince Albert Victor - he was even a suspect in the 'Jack the Ripper' case. Discover the truth here.
pr.sub: Albert Victor: The Prince and the Ripper

pr.d: A recurring mine marker points the team east to neighbouring Harrison Lake as leads and legend line up; clues found in a 1950s article by an investigative reporter place a lost Spanish gold mine directly on Slumach's path.
pr.sub: The Journey to the Lost Mine

pr.d: Adam and Kru scour the Breakenridge landslide for evidence of Slumach's legendary lost gold at a lost Spanish mine east of the Pitt on Harrison Lake. Meanwhile, Taylor and cousin Rain Pierre find new information concerning Slumach's trial, death and burial.
In Norwich, the UK's most Tudor city, Professor Alice Roberts learns about religious intolerance, uncovers the Norwich FC canary's origins and experiences humiliating Tudor justice.

Alice tells the story of Norman England by studying the history of Winchester, Britain's most Norman city. Alice attempts to storm a castle in chain mail, investigates the origins of modern surgery and tucks in to an appetising eel pie.

Dr Alice Roberts looks at some excavations that offer a different perspective on the Vikings. She searches in the Outer Hebrides and Orkney for early Viking settlements. The Viking chief's citadel reveals information about their way of life.

Sherry stellt Michael und Mike vor eine Herausforderung. Wer am besten für Weihnachten dekoriert. Die Familie gibt alles, um jedes Haus mit einem einzigartigen Thema zu schmücken, und sorgt dabei für jede Menge Überraschungen.

Emma Roberts schließt sich mit Jonathan und Drew zusammen, um ihre ehrenamtliche Tante Mela mit einer individuell gestalteten Küchentransformation zu überraschen. Nach einem Leben voller Wohltätigkeit soll Mela einen vielseitigen Raum bekommen.

Sarah Silverman tut sich mit Jonathan und Drew zusammen, um eine Renovierung für ihre beste Freundin durchzuführen. Sarah bringt die Witze und den Presslufthammer mit, um die Wohnräume in dem veralteten Reihenhaus ihrer Freundin aufzufrischen.
Amy und Jess wünschen sich für ihre beiden kleinen Kinder endlich mehr Platz. Dank einer Erbschaft können sie ihr beengtes Haus in Michigan gegen ein größeres Zuhause tauschen.

Nach dem Tod ihres Vaters will Tina endlich ihren Traum verwirklichen: ein Haus in South Carolina, in dem sie für immer bleiben kann. Mit 275.000 Dollar aus ihrem Erbe sucht sie gemeinsam mit David Bromstad rund um Myrtle Beach.

Ein Paar aus Florida knackt den höchsten Jackpot des Staates und gewinnt 15 Millionen Dollar. David Bromstad berät die Familie, die das Geld in eine Immobilie investieren möchte. Zuerst muss die Familie entscheiden, was genau sie sucht.

Marcie hat dank David Bromstad ihre Traumimmobilie auf Cape Cod gefunden. Seitdem hat sich in ihrem Leben einiges verändert. Marcie erklärt sich sogar bereit, ihr Haus gegen ein Ferienhaus im South Shore Corridor von Massachusetts einzutauschen.

Makler David Bromstad hilft neuen Lotto-Millionären beim Geldausgeben für ein Traumhaus. Viele stehen vor der ersten großen Investition in ihrem neuen Leben. Nicht immer fällt die Entscheidung für Luxus. Manche bleiben auch bescheiden.
pr.sub: Wenn der Urlaubsort zum Wohnort wird

pr.d: Die Geburtstagsfeier in Las Vegas endet mit einem satten Gewinn. Das Paar sucht ein Familienhaus am Rand der Stadt der Glücksspieler. Immobilienmakler David Bromstad hilft den Neu-Millionären bei der Suche nach einem passenden neuen Zuhause.

Caitlin und Zach wollen ein Haus, das perfekt auf die Bedürfnisse ihrer vierköpfigen Familie angepasst ist. Josh entwirft für sie eine revolutionäre Treppe, die gleichzeitig als versteckter Vorratsschrank dient und über eine Kindersicherung verfügt. Die kleinen Kinder des Paares bekommen ihr eigenes Etagenbett, das sich in der Wand versenken lässt, um einem Spielbereich Platz zu machen. Außerdem enthält das Haus eine Menge Stauraum und multifunktionale Besonderheiten.

Chrissys Anliegen ist es, den Planeten zu schützen. Daher will sie so viele recycelte Materialien wie möglich für ihr Minihaus in Burlington, Vermont, verwenden. Ihr Baumeister Seth hält nicht sehr viel von ihrer Idee wegen der Abnutzung solcher Materialien. Doch die beiden müssen sich einigen, um den Termin für Chrissys Einzug einhalten zu können, und vielleicht wird sie einige ihrer grünen Träume doch noch aufgeben müssen.

Cody und Alexia aus Texas heuern einen Baumeister an, der sich auf Minihäuser mit großem Wiederverkaufswert spezialisiert hat. Bo entwirft eine Loftetage, die sich toll als Babyzimmer eignet und den Wiederverkaufswert steigert, wenn das Baby größer ist. Das schöne Haus hat auch noch andere gut verkäufliche Merkmale wie einen maßgeschneiderten Kleiderschrank mit einer Treppe und eine normal große Küche.

Nachdem sie eine Nahtoderfahrung hatten, haben Joe und April beschlossen, dass die Zeit für eine Veränderung gekommen ist. Bruce und Bart entwerfen das perfekte Minihaus für die kleine Familie, bevor sie nach North Carolina umzieht. Das Haus wurde entworfen, um den Bedürfnissen jeden Familienmitglieds entgegenzukommen und hat eine Gourmetküche für den Profikoch Joe, schnörkelloses Design, das Aprils Geschmack entspricht, und viel Raum zum Spielen für ihre Tochter Sophie.

Die US-amerikanische Tanzlehrerin Andrea verlässt Ohio, um sich ein neues Leben in der tschechischen Hauptstadt Prag aufzubauen. Nun sucht sie nach einer schönen Wohnung in der historischen Altstadt. Kompromisse will sie keine eingehen.
Der Wunsch nach einem neuen Abenteuer bringt eine Familie nach Budapest. Das junge Paar stellt sein Leben auf den Kopf. Doch sie haben unterschiedliche Erwartungen an ihr neues Zuhause.

Eine junge Frau, die in Amerika lebt, sucht nach einem schönen neuen Zuhause in Budapest, um ihre Wurzeln dort wiederzuentdecken. Ihr Budget ist für Ungarn relativ hoch, doch auch dort ist der Immobilienmarkt stark umkämpft.
A flat in Sutton in London, a studio apartment in Chatham in Kent and a terraced house in Middlesbrough are all sold under the hammer. Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the new owners.

A bungalow in Biggin Hill with huge potential, a centuries-old cottage in a beautiful part of Devon and an end terrace crying out for an upstairs bathroom are all sold under the hammer. Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the new owners and hear their plans.

Martel Maxwell joins the team, and looks at an old mews house in an historic part of Litchfield in Staffordshire, while Martin Roberts assesses the potential of a bungalow in Hanley in Stoke-on-Trent.

Martel Maxwell looks at a large terraced house in Dover in Kent with bags of potential, Martin Roberts is in Camborne in Cornwall viewing a house with lots of issues, and Dion Dublin meets a couple who bought a flat in Woodford Green in Essex.

Martel Maxwell is in Gillingham in Kent meeting a couple embarking on their first renovation development, Martin Roberts talks to a man with ambitious plans for a house in London's Chingford, and Dion Dublin looks round a semi in Wolverhampton.

Martel Maxwell hears development plans for a two-bedroom flat in Godalming in Surrey, Martin Roberts looks at a house in a terrible state of repair in Telford in Shropshire, and Dion Dublin sizes up the work needing to be done at a terraced house in Smethwick in the West Midlands.

pr.sub: Paddington and Paddingtron's Heroic Day / Paddington's Heroic Non-Stop Adventure

pr.d: Paddington seeks the mystery hero doing good deeds, Paddington gets stuck in an igloo.
pr.sub: Paddington and the Unlikely Hero / Paddington Needs a Hero

pr.d: Paddington tries to find out who his favourite hero is, so he sets out with Judy. Paddington really wants to participate in a skating competition, but he can't. Until Mateo gives him a helping hand with a magical mask.
pr.sub: Paddington's Favourite Hero; Paddington and the Skateboarder

pr.d: It's raining, and Peppa is sad because she cannot play outside. However, when the rain stops, Peppa and George get to play one of their favourite games, namely jumping in muddy puddles.
Peppa's family go to the museum's moon exhibition with George's friend, Edmond Elephant.
Peppa and her friends go to help at Edmond Elephant's birthday party, but the little children are harder to look after than they'd thought.
Peppa and her family are at the swimming pool. George is a little worried at first but is soon splashing happily with his friend Richard Rabbit.
Playgroup is having a pet competition and everyone has brought their pets. Dr Hamster is the judge, but it is so hard to choose the best pet.
Peppa and family go on a walk through the forest where they meet all of their favourite fairytale characters. They visit the home of bears who like porridge and meet a hungry Mr Wolf.
While enjoying a tea break, Mr Bull accidentally breaks his delicate teapot. He takes the pieces to Miss Rabbit in the hope that she can mend it.
pr.sub: Mr Bull in a China Shop

pr.d: Peppa and George have a fancy dress party and all their friends are invited. Peppa dresses as a fairy princess and George as a scary dinosaur.
Peppa and George go on a boat trip with Grandpa Pig, but they must send Polly Parrot for help when their boat runs aground. Polly fetches Granny Pig and Grandad Dog to rescue them.

Peppa has a new pen pal, a little donkey from France named Delphine. Peppa receives letters from Delphine Donkey and speaks to her on the telephone. Although Peppa speaks English and Delphine speaks French, they discover that they love lots of the same things, especially jumping up and down in muddy puddles.
Grandpa Pig is planting seeds to make a flower garden, but the birds keep eating them, so Peppa and George help Grandpa Pig to make a scarecrow, which stops the birds eating Grandpa's seeds.

Mummy and Daddy Pig let Peppa and George put their coats on over their pyjamas and go outside to look at the stars. With the help of a telescope, Daddy Pig teaches Peppa and George how to find the North Star.
Mummy Dog surprises Captain Daddy Dog with a gift of a boat trip for his birthday, but when Peppa and the gang come along, the trip doesn't go to plan.
Peppa and George visit Mr Fox's Shop to buy Granny and Grandpa an anniversary present, but have trouble choosing from the shop that sells everything.

Peppa and her family are going for a drive. Suddenly their car breaks down, and it has to go to Granddad Dog's garage to be fixed. While their car is fixed, they borrow a shiny new, blue car from Granddad Dog.
Peppa and George discover frogs, worms and butterflies in Granny Pig and Grandpa Pig's garden, and they play with them. Then Peppa, George and Grandpa have fun jumping in muddy puddles.
Peppa and George make everyone laugh when they dress up as Mummy and Daddy Pig.
Peppa gets shiny new red shoes and never wants to take them off, until it's time to jump in muddy puddles.
Peppa is feeling unwell and Doctor Brown Bear says she must stay in bed. Peppa's friends come to cheer her up.
Peppa and George have fun in the snow, as they make footprints, snowballs and build a snowman.
Grandpa Pig takes Peppa and George to the playground, but does not understand the children's rules.
Peppa and her family visit a new theme park where there is lots of fun to be had with vegetables.
Peppa and George visit Daddy Pig's office and meet his colleagues. Mr Rabbit works with numbers, while Mrs Cat seems to spend her time drawing shapes on a computer.
Peppa's family is staying at Cousin Chloe's house. It's been a long day and everyone is tired and sleepy, but baby Alexander keeps everyone awake with his crying.

Perlas High-School-Tanz steht an, aber sie hat einen Pickel auf der Backe, der ihr die Stimmung vermiest. Mr. Krabs beauftragt SpongeBob mit der Beseitigung des Pickels. Patrick muss inzwischen auf Gary aufpassen, da SpongeBob seine Oma besucht.
Squidina hires an assistant who's a little too good at his job. 'The Patrick Star Show' is interrupted due to a peculiar stench.
pr.sub: Squidina's Little Helper; I Smell a Pat

pr.d: An einem gemütlichen Sonntag bekommt SpongeBob von Sandy die Aufgabe, auf ihre Baumkuppel aufzupassen. Kiemi G, Thaddäus Idol, gibt derweil ein Konzert in Bikini Bottom, der Abend entwickelt sich jedoch nicht wie erhofft.
pr.sub: Der Hüter der Baumkuppel; Ein Abend mit Kiemi G'

pr.d: The Star Family heads to their favourite resort in 'Gas Station Vacation', then in 'Bunny the Barbarian', Bunny goes on a midday adventure to a forgotten age.
pr.sub: Gas Station Vacation; Bunny the Barbarian

pr.d: Patrick und SpongeBob entwickeln Seifenblasen aus scharfer Sauce, die Sandys Luftspeicher zerstören. Also müssen die beiden für Nachschub sorgen, derweil kommt Sandys Karatelehrer zu Besuch und SpongeBob will auch eine Prüfung ablegen.
pr.sub: Verschärfte Bläschen; Der Weg des Schwamms

pr.d: SpongeBob and his pals journey to the North Pole to give Santa a present.

Sandy hat ein Wachstumsserum entwickelt, das Mr. Krabs an einer Kraboulette ausprobiert. Das Serum wirkt und die Riesin hat mächtig Hunger. Kumpelblase schickt mit der Post seinen Sohn, damit SpongeBob auf ihn aufpasst.
pr.sub: Die Kraboulette, die Bikini Bottom fraß; Seifig und durchtrieben

pr.d: Mrs. Puff's new substitute teacher gives SpongeBob a crash course in driving; Mr. Krabs and Plankton must work together after discovering a well of miracle-grease under their restaurants.
pr.sub: Potato Puff; There Will Be Grease!

pr.d: Thaddäus will endlich Ruhe von SpongeBob und zieht dafür sogar vor Gericht. Und Plankton schafft es, einen Krabbenburger aus der Krossen Krabbe zu klauen, ahnt jedoch nicht, dass es sich dabei nur um ein Kunstwerk handelt.
Max takes on a group of freshmen to be his minions, but when they turn the tables and prank him, he must work out how to regain his hard-earned reputation as the worst boy in school.

SpongeBob will seinem Freund und Nachbarn etwas Gutes tun und hilft ihm, seine schönste Erinnerung zu kreieren. Und: SpongeBob und Sandy müssen einen bösen Quallenanführer besiegen, denn ganz Bikini Bottom ist in Gefahr.
pr.sub: Allerhöchstes Glück; Der Planet der Quallen

pr.d: Frustrated by rules, Phoebe and Max make Hank and Barb act like teenagers. But now Phoebe and Max have the responsibility of being the parents.

Weil Plankton Gratisproben in seinem Restaurant verteilt, muss Mr. Krabs mit einer Verzweiflungstat kontern. SpongeBob ruft seine Freunde herbei, damit diese ihm bei der Reparatur seines Hauses behilflich sind.
When Dr Minyak plans to ruin Double G's worldwide charity concert, Captain Man and Kid Danger join forces with the Game Shakers to defeat Dr Minyak and keep Double G safe.

SpongeBob versucht verzweifelt einzuschlafen, während Patrick unbedingt wach bleiben möchte. Das sorgt für Spannungen. SpongeBobs und Patricks Gesichter frieren ein, nachdem sie zu viele Grimassen geschnitten haben.
When Dr Minyak plans to ruin Double G's worldwide charity concert, Captain Man and Kid Danger join forces with the Game Shakers to defeat Dr Minyak and keep Double G safe.

SpongeBob und Patrick spielen ein Spiel, bei dem es darum geht, wer am längsten eine Grimasse ziehen kann. Aber dann bleiben ihre Gesichter so. Außerdem besuchen SpongeBob und Patrick gemeinsam das Handschuhland zum letzten Mal.
Hope charms a flock of parrots guarding a fig tree, and they make her their leader. It's School President election time, and the Twins are running against each other and Bibi!
pr.sub: Parrot pickle / On the Campaign Tail

pr.d: Der 1. April ist SpongeBobs absoluter Lieblingstag, denn er kann einen Tag lang nur Unsinn treiben. SpongeBob reist zur Hall of Fame der Fastfood-Köche. Dort findet er rein zufällig einen alten Pfannenheber ohne Besitzer.

In Bikini Bottom taucht ein mysteriöser Haken auf, der zur Gefahr für SpongeBob wird. SpongeBob gewinnt ein Muschelhorn, mit dem er die Superhelden Meerjungfraumann und Blaubarschbube jederzeit rufen kann.

Thaddäus will einen potenziellen neuen Nachbarn, mit dem er sich anfreunden möchte, von SpongeBob und Patrick fernhalten, um ihn nicht zu verschrecken. Thaddäus verliebt sich derweil in eine Kundin und SpongeBob soll ihm helfen, sie zu verführen.
pr.sub: Quallenfischendes Seifenblasenbläserpack; Ein Tintenfisch zum Verlieben

pr.d: Justa Smurf, surrounded by others who are all Something Smurf, is still searching for his calling.
Farmer hires Willow's pet carnivorous plant to watch over his crops. Papa Smurf prepares a potion to boost his strength, but its effects are heavily altered due to a spider's intrusion.

Patricks brutale Schwester ist zu Besuch und hinterlässt eine Spur von Chaos und Zerstörung, doch Thaddäus will sie stoppen. Sandy und Plankton arbeiten zusammen an einem Teleporter, allerdings kennt Sandy nicht Planktons Plan für die Verwendung.
pr.sub: Geschwister des Grauens; Die Chemie stimmt

pr.d: While Papa Smurf is away, Brainy uses a potion to get the Village to obey his every whim.
Baby Smurf finds Handy's cuckoo clock and ends up travelling through time. Chef Smurf must investigate when someone steals the festival cake.
pr.sub: Smurfily Gmurfy; Smurf T for Thief

pr.d: Thaddäus verletzt sich beim Schlafen im Lagerraum, nun droht er Krabs mit einem Gang zur obersten Werktätigen-Sicherheitsbehörde. Derweil eröffnet eine neue Burgerbude in Bikini Bottom und Mr. Krabs und Plankton versuchen das Burgerrezept zu klauen.
Bubble Bass finds himself stranded with Patrick in a mysterious swamp, looking for a lost action figure; SpongeBob learns a new magic trick, but he can't find anyone to watch it.

Mr. Krabs erweitert die Krosse Krabbe um einen Drive-In-Schalter. Schnell ist das komplette Straßennetz in Bikini Bottom deshalb verstopft. SpongeBob bekommt derweil von einem Rennfahrer-Sohn Boots-Unterricht und wird selbst zum Rennfahrer.

Plankton creates a clone of himself and Mr Krabs, but neither restaurant is safe from the newcomer. Squidward gleefully switches jobs with a bus driver for an easy ride until SpongeBob and Patrick climb aboard.
pr.sub: The Krusty Bucket; Squid's on a Bus

pr.d: SpongeBob und Patrick bauen in SpongeBobs Wohnzimmer eine Minigolf-Anlage auf. Allerdings verlagert sich das Spiel in Thaddäus Haus, außerdem will SpongeBob alle Andenken an Erlebnisse mit Patrick aufbewahren, und wird zum krankhaften Sammler.

pr.d: Desperate to avenge last year's humiliating loss, the chipmunks argue over who is best suited to lead them to victory; Alvin grows tired of seeing his celebrity status overshadowed by reality TV stars, so he decides to become one himself.

In order to get Theodore to do his bidding, Alvin tells him that he has secret powers and can turn rubbish into candy; when the chipmunks find a baby bird that has fallen from its nest, Alvin is reluctant to get too attached.

Brittany takes up painting to impress her fashion idol, but her idol only likes her art after Alvin ruins it; Alvin is convinced that Julie and her son are trying to move in to their home, so he tries to stop the invasion.
SpongeBob and Patrick accidentally launch a rocket and mistakenly think they have landed on the moon. Mr. Krabs gives SpongeBob an odd pair of shoes.
SpongeBob decides to leave his industrialised life and live off the land with the jellyfish. Fed up with SpongeBob and Patrick, Squidward decides to sell his house.
There's a talent show at the Krusty Krab and Squidward takes over the planning. The evil Plankton tries to steal a Krusty Krab's Krabby Patty.
When Alvin gets hurt, Simon agrees to face off against Derek on a survival reality show; Alvin accidentally ruins Brittany's favourite bag and must come up with a way to replace it.
pr.sub: I Will Survive; Alvin's Got a Brand New Bag

pr.d: The Chipmunks take in a stray dog, but have to keep the puppy hidden from Dave, who won't allow pets. Theodore orders a dragon egg in the hopes of it hatching into a real dragon.
Alvin helps the mathletes stand up to the school bullies, but in the process they become bullies themselves; Alvin befriends a new student, but Theodore learns something surprising about him.

Marie Marvelle, ein belgischer Filmstar, wendet sich an Poirot, weil sie seit einiger Zeit mysteriöse Briefe erhält. In diesen wird sie aufgefordert, einen Diamanten, den sie besitzt, zurückzugeben, andernfalls werde er ihr gestohlen.

Poirot hätte Hastings wahrscheinlich nicht auf den winterlichen Jagdausflug begleitet, wenn ihm nicht delikate Moorschneehühner zur Belohnung gewunken hätten. Aber leider erkältet sich Poirot stark, wird bettlägerig und verliert seinen Appetit.

Ein inszeniertes Krimievent wird zur bitteren Realität, als der Hauptdarsteller in der Rolle des Detektivs erstochen aufgefunden wird. Um einen drohenden Medienrummel zu verhindern, muss Janie diesen Fall nun so schnell wie möglich lösen.
Eine Explosion, in die eine geheimnisvolle Frau verwickelt ist, der Watts nachgeht, führt Murdoch zu einer geheimen Gemeinschaft.

Der Tod einer professionellen Rollschuhläuferin wirkt zunächst wie ein Unfall. Bei seinen Ermittlungen stößt Murdoch auf Rivalitäten im Wettkampf und er findet sich alsbald in einer Welt von gnadenlos ehrgeizigen jungen Frauen wieder.

Poirot wird vom Wirt eines Landgasthofs per Brief gebeten, einen dreifachen Giftmord aufzuklären. Bei seiner Ankunft muss er jedoch erfahren, dass das Verbrechen nur auf dem Papier existiert: im selbstverfassten Kriminalroman des Wirts.

Quicklebendig und gut gelaunt begrüßt Schauspieler und Comedian Nico Stank SWR-Moderator Pierre M. Krause - und führt etwas im Schilde. Seine Schildkröte braucht neues Futter. So eilen beide im Schildkrötentempo ins Zoofachgeschäft.
pr.sub: Nico Stanks Zug hat keine Bremsen

pr.d: Auf dem Hinflug nach Venedig ist Pauline so übel geworden, dass sie alleine aus Venedig mit dem Zug zurückfährt. Ihren gemeinsamen romantischen Abend wollen Pauline und Daniel nun im "Fürstenhof" nachholen - doch zu Paulines Erstaunen steht zunächst Leonard vor ihrer Tür. Er muss erkennen, dass sich Pauline tatsächlich in seinen alten Freund verliebt hat. Währenddessen kommen Charlotte und Friedrich wieder zusammen und Friedrich beschließt, zurück zu ihr in die Wohnung zu ziehen.

Tina platzt völlig aufgelöst in Paulines und Daniels Rendezvous. Mitfühlend spendet ihr Pauline Trost und Daniel zieht sich rücksichtsvoll zurück. Auch bei einem Ausritt am Tag darauf, der im Stroh endet, werden sie in ihrer Zweisamkeit gestört. Friedrich will sich nicht weiter von Werner erpressen lassen, doch er steht nach seinem Wiedereinzug bei Charlotte erneut unter Druck. Coco fällt aus allen Wolken, als Pauline ihr von Tinas Kummer berichtet.

pr.sub: Die March - Ein Fluss wie damals

pr.d: Die Alpen sind dem Klimawandel der vergangenen Jahre nicht länger gewachsen. Auch das atemberaubende Grün, das spektakuläre Farbenspiel und das Aufeinandertreffen von Sonne und Natur wird durch das Klima stark beeinflusst.

Wenn der Frühling wärmeres Wetter und längere Tage bringt, beginnt die Brutzeit in ganz Schottland. Otter, Seeadler, Papageitaucher und Schneehasen gehen auf Partnersuche. Schon bald müssen sie alle hungrigen Nachwuchs versorgen und sie großziehen.

Der Sommer ist endlich in Schottland angekommen und bringt längere Tage und eine Fülle von Lebensmitteln. An Schottlands Westküste lernen zwei Seeadlerjungen das Fliegen, und ihre große Schwester kennt beim Futter keine Gnade.

Es ist Herbst in Schottland und die Uhr tickt. Wenn das Tageslicht abnimmt und das Wetter abkühlt, schwinden auch die Nahrungsressourcen. Die Tiere müssen entweder jetzt migrieren oder sich auf den langen Winter vorbereiten.

Schottland erlebt einen ungewöhnlich warmen Winter. Für die Tiere ist das oft ein Problem. Ohne Schnee sind zum Beispiel die weißen Schneehasen nicht getarnt und werden zur leichten Beute der Adler. Für Eichhörnchen bringt das Wetter aber Vorteile.

The Best Of the Days Shopping Quarter Highlights.

Eine Frau, die an Lungenversagen leidet, wird ins Krankenhaus eingeliefert. Dr. House denkt nach den ersten Untersuchungen jedoch, dass die Frau nur simuliert. Doch dieses Mal sollte er sich täuschen, denn kurze Zeit später wird auch ihr Mann mit Herzproblemen eingeliefert.

Liebt Cameron House? Die folgenreiche Frage beschäftigt Chase nach deren plötzlichem Rückzug. Auch House und sein Team wundern sich über die Intensität, mit der Cameron ihren Rat sucht im Fall eines Umweltschützers, der das Wohl der Erde über alles stellt. Wilson hingegen macht sich Sorgen um seinen Freund. Was ihm gelingt, schafft House nicht: die Toten loszulassen.

House erhält Hilfe aus dem Jenseits: Amber verhilft ihm zu Diagnosen aus dem Blauen, zur Verwunderung seines Teams. Im Fall eines gehörlosen Patienten jedoch, welcher der Liebe wegen nichts hören will, bringt sie ihren Ex-Chef mit ihren Einflüsterungen in Schwierigkeiten. Chase überlässt House, Wilsons Warnung zum Trotz, die Ausrichtung seines Polterabends. Dieser bereitet sich enthusiastisch vor.

Die Befreiung von Cleo und Landon kann nur klappen, wenn Hope eng mit ihren Freunden zusammenarbeitet. Sie kann jedoch nicht wissen, dass Alaric und Kaleb ihr etwas verschweigen. Cleo und Landon schließen sich derweil zusammen.

Detektiv Bell wird Opfer eines feigen Anschlages, als er eine Tasche auf dem Revier untersuchen will. Die Bombe wird genau in dem Moment gezündet, als er die Tasche öffnet. Die Ermittler gehen davon aus, dass der Täter alles genau beobachtet hat.

pr.t: Modern Home Design - Neu gedacht, neu gemacht
pr.d: Die Carricos möchten das Design ihres alten Hauses modernisieren, um ihm mehr Funktionalität und Stauraum zu verleihen. Deshalb bitten sie Brooke und Brice, ihnen zu helfen, ein stimmiges Design mit einem familienfreundlichen Grundriss zu erreichen.

pr.t: Modern Home Design - Neu gedacht, neu gemacht
pr.d: Brooke und Brice helfen einem befreundeten Paar, das gerade geheiratet hat. Das Schlafzimmer in ihrem Haus braucht eine Renovierung, und zusammen mit Brice schafft Brooke eine friedliche Oase, in der sie sich entspannen können.

Dawn und Jeff haben ein Haus gekauft, das sie nun umbauen möchten. Das Innere ist noch nicht ideal. Sie planen, die Räume zu öffnen, Wände zu entfernen und die Küche sowie das Wohnzimmer zu modernisieren. Problematisch sind die kleinen Bäder.
Tarek und Heather haben mit einem geräumigen Haus im spanischen Stil alle Hände voll zu tun.

Steve and Rob are joined at the Hotel Grande Bretagne by Emma and photographer Yolanda. They strike a pose at the Epidaurus Amphitheatre. Then, it is on to Hydra for a long lunch, before Steve finds romance on the waterfront.
Rob and Steve set sail for Rimini, where they reflect on their middle age. Then it's off to the caves of Dios for some a cappella.
Rob and Steve's island-hopping tour is cut short in King Nestor's home of Pylos as Steve receives some bad news. It makes for an emotional journey home.

On the 1983 federal election night, Labor wins by a landslide and Bob Hawke becomes the new prime minister. On Oxford Street, there is an eruption of celebration. This could mean a big step forward in the fight for equality.
Turning up the heat on the Marshalls, Duke is drawn in deeper than he ever could have imagined.
London's gangland is pushed to the brink of war; but for Duke, the consequences strike painfully close to home.
After being dumped and fired on the same day, Sabi contemplates an opportunity that would change their entire life, until an unexpected accident puts their new plans in jeopardy.
Competition is fierce as local merchant Robert and wife Kelly open up a fish and chip restaurant, plus follow the journey of the turbot as it goes from sea to the dinner plate.
A woman suffers amnesia after a car accident in Los Angeles. With help from an aspiring actress, the mysterious woman searches for clues as to who she really is.

Skilled operatives travel to an island research facility to secure life-saving DNA from dinosaurs. As the top-secret mission becomes more and more dangerous, they soon make a sinister, shocking discovery that's been hidden from the world for decades.

pr.t: xXx: The Return of Xander Cage
pr.d: After coming out of self-imposed exile, daredevil operative Xander Cage must race against time to recover a sinister weapon known as Pandora's Box, a device that controls every military satellite in the world. Recruiting a new group of thrill-seeking cohorts, Xander finds himself entangled in a deadly conspiracy that points to collusion at the highest levels of government.

pr.t: The Fast and the Furious: Tokyo Drift
pr.d: Street-racing sequel following an adrenaline-junkie automobile addict who narrowly avoids jail by agreeing to move in with his father in Tokyo. However, he soon discovers the thrill of the local underground drift racing scene and unwittingly becomes involved with the Yakuza.
Previews of the great films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky.

An amnesiac schoolteacher discovers she was formerly a government assassin when she hires a low-rent private eye to help fill the gaps in her memory. Together, they go on the run in a race against the clock to stop her former taskmasters from putting a heinous plan into action, before they can silence her for good.

Chazz Michael Michaels and Jimmy MacElroy are the two titans of skating. At the 🏅 [Olympics] Winter Olympics, the fierce rivals find themselves forced to share the winner's podium when they both score gold. The shower of glory doesn't last for long, as the pair descend into fisticuffs and set the mascot on fire. Disgraced and stripped of their medals, they can get back on ice, but only if they dance with each other as a pair.

West Virginia family man Jimmy Logan teams up with his one-armed brother Clyde and sister Mellie to steal money from the Charlotte Motor Speedway in North Carolina. Jimmy also recruits demolition expert Joe Bang to help them break into the track's underground system. Complications arise when a mix-up forces the crew to pull off the heist during a popular 🏁 [NASCAR] NASCAR race, while also trying to dodge a relentless FBI agent.

Greg and Pam have been together for ten years, and now they're the proud parents of two adorable twins. However, money is tight and in order to keep his family afloat, devoted nurse Greg takes a second job working for a drug company. That development doesn't sit well with Jack, whose previous suspicions regarding his hapless son-in-law soon come back in full force after learning of this development.
A teen suffers the pain of adolescence as she longs for Mr Right while fending off the advances of the class clown.
The story of Harry Dhillon, who once attacked an ex-girlfriend in a jealous frenzy before brutally murdering Alice Ruggles after a campaign of harassment following the end of their relationship.
The story behind the murders of 12-year-old Alice, her 18-year-old sister Xing, and their parents Jifeng and Ge, killed when businessman Anxiang Du targeted their Northampton home in 2011.
In 2002, Heath McGowan murdered 88-year-old Henry Marriott in his own Michigan home, but the case against the violent criminal would prove complicated for police investigators.

A look at how forensic science can help police solve serious crimes where the truth seems impossible to uncover. As the various twists and turns of each case unfold, the role of forensic science in providing answers is highlighted and examined.

A driver gets pulled over with brake lights that do not work, but that is not the end of the matter, as they have also manipulated their odometer to save on fees.
A driver is pulled over for a random breath test, when the officers discover empty beer bottles in the back seat of the car, proving that the driver is intoxicated.
Leading senior constable Rob Jones pulls over an out-of-control drunk driver. The man is so drunk, he has vomited everywhere.
Leading senior constable Pete Henry discovers a man, a cat, and a funny hat. It's anything but a child's bedtime story.

Moving tale about an 11-year-old tomboy growing up in the 1970s. The girl harbours the secret belief that she is responsible for her mother's death in childbirth, and is troubled by her father's new relationship with a beautician at his funeral parlour. However, the girl finds a way through her emotional difficulties with the help of her best friend.

Set to his most beloved songs is the epic musical story of Elton John, from his breakthrough years in the 1970s to his fantastical transformation from shy piano prodigy to international superstar and pop icon.

Life is a struggle for single father Chris Gardner. Evicted from their flat, he and his young son find themselves alone with no place to go. Even though Chris eventually lands a job as an intern at a prestigious brokerage firm, the position pays no money. The pair must live in shelters and endure many hardships, but Chris refuses to give in to despair as he struggles to create a better life for himself and his son.

pr.t: The Cinema List: Black British Actors
pr.d: This Black History Month, explore a varied selection of films and have a look at the work of some exceptionally talented Black British actors, from Naomie Harris to Idris Elba and beyond.
Young Jim has to grow up fast after the Japanese invade Shanghai. Separated from his parents and alone in a prisoner of war camp, Jim must fight to survive.

A mysterious portal pulls four misfits into the Overworld, a bizarre, cubic wonderland that thrives on imagination. To get back home, they'll have to master the terrain while embarking on a magical quest with an unexpected crafter named Steve.

After moving to New York City, kung fu prodigy Li Fong enters a karate competition -- but his skills alone aren't enough. With help from Mr. Han and Daniel LaRusso, he soon learns to merge two styles into one for the ultimate martial arts showdown.
Yogi, Boo Boo, and Ranger Smith team up to try to stop the mayor from closing Jellystone Park and selling it to loggers.

A pregnant woman was deserted by her partner. When she goes into labour, a friendly taxi driver rushes her to hospital and the pair become firm friends. He slowly falls in love with her and her baby, but she's still looking for the perfect partner, not realising he's right under her nose. However, we can hear the baby's thoughts, and he wants the guy as his dad.
A wisecracking toddler deals with toilet training, bickering parents and a baby sister in this sequel to the 1989 hit.

Reluctant one-man army Rambo goes into action against brutal Soviet invaders in Afghanistan. Sought out in a Buddhist monastery retreat, Rambo declines his former commander's request for help to deliver missiles to the mujahideen, but when his superior is captured and imprisoned, the hulking hero brings out the big guns.
One man's brutal campaign for vengeance takes on national stakes after it's revealed he's a former operative of a powerful and clandestine organisation known as Beekeepers.

Small-time crooks One Two and Mumbles decide to legitimately invest in some prime real estate and find themselves out of their depth and in debt to old-school London gangster Lenny Cole. Cole himself is in the middle of a business deal with a Russian gangster, but when his accountant tips off One Two and Mumbles to the details of an upcoming big-money business transaction, the two scallywags swoop in and steal the cash.

Six government agents become trapped inside a high-security safe house after a terrorist attack in downtown Los Angeles. They soon realise they must survive not just the enemy outside, but the potential traitor among them.
On a mission to find a new master to serve, three Minions meet Scarlet Overkill, the world's first female super-villain.
With the evil wizard Gargamel hot on their trail, Smurfette, Brainy, Clumsy and Hefty embark on a journey through the Forbidden Forest to find a mysterious village.

pr.t: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
pr.d: SpongeBob goes on a quest to discover a stolen recipe that takes him to our world, where he tangles with a pirate.

Mumble's son Erik hasn't yet found his talents, and he goes with his friends to Adélie-land which is ruled by a penguin who can fly. When Erik returns to Emperor-land and finds them trapped under big walls of ice. Will Erik be able to save his family and friends before it is too late?
Previews of the great films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky.

Migo is a friendly Yeti who discovers something that he didn't know existed: a human. When his fellow villagers refuse to believe him, Migo embarks on an epic journey to find the mysterious creature that can put him back in good graces.

Free Eden employee Apple secretly runs a witchy femme cult in the basement of a mall store after hours. When a new hire challenges their performative sisterhood, the women are forced to face their own poisons or succumb to a bloody fate.
Identical twins Abigail and Charlie travel to Wales to manage a bookshop for Christmas. Romance and mistaken identity follow as two local men woo the sisters, unaware they are twins.

pr.t: Holiday Touchdown: A Bears Love Story
pr.d: Sparks fly between an ambitious freelance reporter and a handsome firefighter after she lands a feel-good story about a 🏈🐻 [NFL] Chicago Bears superfan who's about to attend her 500th game.
Years after a college newsroom mishap sent Meg and Billy down opposite life paths, they reunite in a small Texas town to save an annual holiday event.

After the loss of her husband, a grieving woman seeks solace with her in-laws at their secluded family home. However, it soon becomes a reunion from hell as the Book of the Dead unleashes demonic forces that transform them into Deadites one by one.

Columbus and Tallahassee have orchestrated a way to survive a world overrun by zombies. With only fear keeping the `big wuss' Columbus alive, Tallahassee wants to eradicate the `last Twinkie on Earth'. The duo join forces with Wichita and Little Rock who have a style and tact of their own when it comes to dealing with the flesh-eating chaos.

The Men in Black have expanded to cover the globe, but so have the villains of the universe. When aliens that can take the form of any human arrive on Earth, H and M embark on a globe-trotting adventure to save the agency -- and ultimately the world.
Previews of the great films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky.

Tony Towers is a local celebrity, a successful nightclub manager and is engaged to a younger woman, Sue. Things get a little strange when he embarks upon the 3:17 to Nottingham for a Christmas family reunion.

An anxious teacher starts a new job at an under-achieving school and quickly finds himself struggling to cope with a wild classroom assistant, a group of under-performing kids and his own very pregnant wife.
The pupils at St Bernadette's primary school are on their best behaviour for the arrival of strict new teacher Mr Shepherd. But when he loses his memory, it's up to the kids to save the day.

After getting a green card in exchange for assassinating a Cuban government official, Tony Montana stakes a claim on the drug trade in Miami. Viciously murdering anyone who stands in his way, Tony eventually becomes the biggest drug lord in the state, controlling nearly all the cocaine that comes through Miami. But increased pressure from the police, wars with Colombian drug cartels and his own drug-fuelled paranoia serve to fuel the flames of his eventual downfall.

A violent and uncompromising police officer hunts for a psychopath who holds the city of San Francisco to ransom. Although the officer's unorthodox methods do not endear him to his superiors, the mayor reluctantly agrees that Harry Callahan seems to be the right cop for the job.

Terror strikes in the heart of Mumbai, India, as members of Lashkar-e-Taiba storm the Taj Mahal Palace Hotel in a series of coordinated attacks throughout the city. Amid the gunfire and mayhem, a brave chef and kitchen worker decide to risk their own lives to try and protect the frightened guests. As the militants continue their assault on the hotel, a desperate couple must do whatever they can to protect their newborn baby.

When food goes missing from all over Tickety Town, Tommy and Tallulah are determined to find the culprit, but their prime suspect keeps changing as they follow the trail of thefts since each of them has also been burgled. Meanwhile, the clockhouse has been overrun by the Spring Chicks' cousins who have come to stay.

Tommy and Tallulah declare it is 'Camping Time' and set off for the Gnarly Tree, but when the Spring Chicks tag along and pester them for their banana muffins, they move camp and forget to tell anyone where they have gone, causing a dreadful panic in town as Chime Time approaches.

Everyone is in the town square, swapping something they do not want for something they do. Hopparoo ends up with Tommy's drum and loves it so much that he refuses to give it back, even with Chime Time looming. The only way he will release it is if the twins can find him a bigger, louder drum to play.
Pocoyo meets a very strange red figure. Pocoyo and this figure become very good friends. The red figure calls his other colourful friends to give a tremendous musical show to Pocoyo and his friends.

Pato gets stuck: he's hanging upside down from the sky. Pocoyo and the friends try to help him down but it's just no use. Eventually they show Pato how much they love and miss him. By taking his mind off the problem, he overcomes it.
Pocoyo finds a box full of musical instruments. When he learns how to use them, he calls on his friends to form a rock band. It doesn't go well at first - but then things get better.
Pocoyo, Pato and Elly go on a picnic. Soon the sandwiches they have in their basket begin to move all by themselves and escape! The three friends pursue the sandwiches and catch them.
Pato has his towel, soap and brush ready for a shower when the phone rings. He goes to answer the phone and when he returns all of his things have disappeared.
Pato is attending to his garden when Pocoyo arrives. Pocoyo wants to plant a flower so Pato lends him a gardening book so that he can follow the steps to make his plant grow.
Pocoyo writes a letter to Elly but needs a postman to deliver it. Luckily Pato is ready to deliver Pocoyo's mail, as well as the post of everyone else.
The friends meet after the holidays eager to tell their adventures, but they are exaggerating a little, including when Pocoyo said he ate an entire planet.

Palau is a tiny country with a big story. In 2009, this island nation in the middle of the western Pacific Ocean created the world's first shark sanctuary to protect more than 100 species from reckless overfishing and the brutal practice of commercial shark finning. Then, in 2014, Palau once again led the way when it established the world's largest marine sanctuary, a no-go zone for foreign commercial fisheries nearly the size of California.

Bam erweckt Catwomans Katzenmobil Kitty zum Leben, damit sie gleichberechtigte Teams für ihr Schlagballspiel aufstellen können. Doch Kitty ist zu wild, um sich zurückhalten zu lassen, trotz Bams größter Versuche, sie zum Mitspielen zu überreden.
Eine Fußballtrophäe wird gestohlen und alles spricht zunächst dafür, dass es Harley war.

Zing und Kitty sind nachts unterwegs zum Hafen, um Keroppi zu überraschen, der mit seinem Boot unterwegs nach Cherry Town ist. Doch plötzlich gehen alle Lichter in der Stadt aus. Obwohl Zing Angst im Dunkeln hat, nimmt sie all ihren Mut zusammen, um mit Kittys Hilfe den Lichtschalter im Leuchtturm wieder anzustellen, damit Keroppi sicher an Land kommen kann.

Nori will am Wettbewerb "die süßeste Süßigkeit der Welt" teilnehmen und backt dafür einen Mega-Kuchen. Allerdings schmeckt er nicht richtig. Es fehlt ihm eine Zutat: Kirsch-Streusel, die nur auf dem Kirsch-Gebirge wachsen.

Während des Ausgrabungsprozesses von Dinosaurierknochen sind das Trio unsicher, wie alles zusammenpasst. Doch die Knochen können die Vergangenheit zeigen und sie sind auf dem richtigen Weg. Außerdem deckt Lofty etwas Wichtiges auf.

Milo und seine Freunde werden zur Kreativität gezwungen. Sie übernehmen den Blumenladen und wollen aus den frischen Blumen ein Kunstwerk erschaffen. Dabei vergessen die Freunde den VIP Anlass und müssen sich eine Lösung einfallen lassen.

Milo und seine Freunde müssen Madame Dolores Ballsaal streichen, um Otto bei einem königlichen Termin zu unterstützen. Dabei sorgen Party-Essen und Bruno für Chaos. Fraglich ist, wie sie die Erwartungen von Ottos Kundin übertreffen können.

pr.d: James May attempts to prove the impossible - that an Englishman can take a penalty and score. He will need to keep a cool head as he'll be taking the penalty in front of 20,000 baying German fans on the exact spot where England were knocked out of the 2006 World Cup. Plus, James reinstates an ancient ferry crossing, creates an indoor garden and builds the world's first multi-functional Swiss Army Bike.

In this Christmas special, James and the team try to create their own Christmas miracle, by making it snow. Oz Clarke is dispatched in a small plane armed with a salt shaker to see if cloud seeding really will produce the desired effect. Back in the 'Man Lab', James invents a Christmas tree decorating blunderbuss gun and discovers the easiest way to wrap presents.

James and the team attempt to catch a lightning bolt using a homemade rocket, before getting serious at an international rock, paper, scissors competition. To reduce soaring crime rates, they create a neighbourhood watch team made entirely of cats.

James May travels to an Oxfordshire town where a royal tradition desperately needs his help. Can he find a way of feeding thousands of locals to save their Diamond Jubilee celebration using ballistics and hot crossed buns? 'Man Lab' also tests once and for all whether it is possible to make your own luck by beating the odds.

He will need to keep a cool head as he'll be taking the penalty in front of 20,000 baying German fans on the exact spot where England were knocked out of the 2006 World Cup. Plus, James reinstates an ancient ferry crossing, creates an indoor garden and builds the world's first multi-functional Swiss Army Bike.

In this Christmas special, James and the team try to create their own Christmas miracle, by making it snow. Oz Clarke is dispatched in a small plane armed with a salt shaker to see if cloud seeding really will produce the desired effect. Back in the 'Man Lab', James invents a Christmas tree decorating blunderbuss gun and discovers the easiest way to wrap presents.

James and the team attempt to catch a lightning bolt using a homemade rocket, before getting serious at an international rock, paper, scissors competition. To reduce soaring crime rates, they create a neighbourhood watch team made entirely of cats.

James May travels to an Oxfordshire town where a royal tradition desperately needs his help. Can he find a way of feeding thousands of locals to save their Diamond Jubilee celebration using ballistics and hot crossed buns? 'Man Lab' also tests once and for all whether it is possible to make your own luck by beating the odds.
Shopping from Home.

Agnes is a Mammy on a mission - trying to make sure grandson Bono isn't sent to the infamous local primary school (despite what his parents want) and as if her house isn't normally noisy enough, she finds herself lumbered with a brand new house guest in the form of a homeless parrot. At least she's got her New Year's Eve party to look forward to - until her guests start dropping like flies. Suddenly it looks like she might be seeing in the New Year without her family around her.

Mike erteilt seiner Tochter eine Lektion, als er sich ohnehin mit ihr in letzter Zeit ständig in die Haare bekommt. Womit Mike jedoch nicht rechnet, ist die Reaktion, die Eve ihm entgegenbringt und er bleibt erstaunt zurück.

Mandy wird unausstehlich, je näher die Hochzeit heranrückt und feuert sogar den Hochzeitsplaner. Dazu kommt, dass sie ihre ganze Familie zu jeder Zeit einspannt und ihrem Bräutigam verbietet, auf seinen Hochzeitsanzug, Turnschuhe zu tragen.

Die Lehrer sind zur Entwicklungswoche zurück, einer Zeit der Vorbereitung auf das kommende Jahr. Janine ist entschlossen, das Jahr richtig zu beginnen und ihre Probleme zu Hause zu lassen. Ava betreibt auf dem Schulparkplatz einen Nebenjob.

Die Jungs müssen ihre WG absichern, als sie planen, zum ersten Mal zusammen LSD zu nehmen. Leider muss Anders zu einem spontanen Arbeitsausflug in ein zwielichtiges Hotel, in dem er einen Kunden namens "Barracuda" treffen soll.

TelAmeriCorp ist in ein neues Bürogebäude gezogen. Weil die Jungs das vergessen haben, kommen sie zu spät und finden keinen Parkplatz mehr. Um die Behindertenparkplätze nutzen zu können, will Adam seinen Cousin zur Arbeit mitbringen.

In dieser neuen Folge sind zwei Gruppen aus dem Osten und dem Westen, die darum wetteifern, wer am besten reimen kann. Außerdem gibt es Mafia-Action und zwei Parkwächter, die nicht glauben können, dass jemand Batman verspotten würde.

Kenny will mit allen Mitteln verhindern, dass seine Eltern noch ein Kind zeugen. Cartman hat unterdessen andere Probleme: Er möchte sich reifere, ältere Freunde suchen. Er nutzt dafür das Internet - und ist erfolgreich. Zumindest fast.

Chef fordert die Änderung der Flagge von South Park, weil er sie für rassistisch hält. Jimbo ist dagegen. Es entbrennt eine heftige Diskussion und nach einer Eskalation können die Kinder in einer Diskussionsveranstaltung die Sache regeln.
Beavis und Butt-Head bleiben auf dem Dach von Tom Andersons Haus stecken. Beavis und Butt-Head unternehmen eine Schlauchbootfahrt auf einem Fluss, verirren sich aber im Meer.

In dieser Episode bekommt Butt-Head Medikamente gegen seine Aggressionen gegenüber Beavis und wird ein wenig zu nett. Zudem gehen Beavis und Butt-Head im mittleren Alter das Biergeld aus, sodass Beavis sich einen Job suchen muss.

Die Mitbewohner treffen sich zum ersten Mal. Foxxy fühlt sich rassistisch beleidigt, als Clara sie für eine Hausangestellte hält. Toot erkennt, dass sie kein Sexsymbol mehr ist. Foxxy und Clara vertragen sich im Whirlpool mit einem Kuss.

Xandir erkennt, dass er sich zu Männern hingezogen fühlt. Doch zunächst versucht er, die Wahrheit über seine Sexualität nicht anzuerkennen. Spanky bemerkt Ling-Lings besonderes Talent zum Nähen und nutzt es für sich aus.

Ingmar will herausfinden, was es bedeutet, politisch korrekt zu sein und ob sich in den letzten Jahren viel verändert hat. Er absolviert sogar einen Test für sich und seine Sendung, doch das Ergebnis ist politisch nicht korrekt.

Cleveland plant eine Überraschung für Donna am Muttertag, doch nicht alles läuft nach Plan. Er heuert eine Schauspielerin an, die Donnas Mutter spielen soll. Doch plötzlich steht ihre richtige Mutter vor der Tür.

Um sich bei Cleveland einzuschmeicheln, erklärt sich Robertas Freund bereit, ihn und seine Freunde zu einem Football-Spiel zu fahren. Dort geraten sie mit Fans der gegnerischen Mannschaft aneinander und versuchen, unbeschadet nach Hause zu kommen.

Läuse-Alarm an der Grundschule von South Park! Die Schulleitung versucht, den Namen des Kindes zu schützen, damit es nicht den dann folgenden Hänseleien ausgesetzt ist. Für Cartman und Co. macht dieser Schutz der Obrigkeit die Suche nach dem Namen natürlich besonders attraktiv und so versuchen sie, den "Täter" über fragwürdige Tests zu entlarven.
With Alex Jones, Danny Dyer and Miles Jupp.
When mysterious power outages strike South America, the townspeople fear Chinese cyberattacks. It's up to the boys to discover what's really going on.

It's Jimmy and Timmy versus Nathan and Mimsy at the upcoming science fair, but things soon go to a whole other level.
Sharon is overreacting to everything these days and Randy cannot cope. Meanwhile, Cartman unexpectedly fails his maths test.
A special relationship develops between Butters and the Parish Priest. So when the town finds the church doors locked and no sign of the pair, they call in the Church.

Jonathan Ross narrates as a new batch of contestants head for the castle. Prepare for thrills, spills and a whole load of soggy shorts as they encounter Stepping Stone and Bridge the Gap.

A 23-year-old woman is found murdered in Florida. Detectives uncover jealousy and obsession as a love rival becomes the prime suspect.

After a woman is found strangled inside her Illinois home, investigators uncover a violent domestic confrontation and a husband who waited hours before calling 911. As the evidence mounts, a troubled marriage ends in a murder.

`How the Universe Works' is an ultimate cosmos operator's manual, a revealing look at the inner workings of outer space. Computer imagery allows viewers to explore black holes, supernovae, neutron stars, dark energy and all the other forces that produce what is and what we see.

NASA's task of reaching beyond the bounds of Earth has uncovered disturbing anomalies that have perplexed even the finest scientific minds. Science Channel digs into the space agency's archives to reveal countless mysteries and unusual encounters, discoveries and sightings. Each hour-long episode scrutinizes evidence, explores possible explanations, and considers testimony from NASA insiders, scientists, astronauts and others who have witnessed the strange phenomena. The stories are made all the more unusual since they come from the most credible scientific organisation in the world.

Intrigued by legendary mysteries and driven by curiosity, Josh Gates is on a mission for answers. `Exhibition Unknown' chronicles his global adventures as he investigates iconic unsolved events, lost cities, buried treasures and other puzzling stories. Armed with a degree in archaeology, a quick wit and a thirst for action, Gates investigates recent developments before embarking on a detailed exploration. Whether he's trekking through Fiji in search of Amelia Earhart's remains or diving the deep seas of Panama to locate Captain Morgan's pirate ship, Gates' roughshod expeditions lead him one step closer to the truth.

TV's most extreme survival challenge just grew extra-large. Veteran survivalists familiar with the stripped-down drill after appearing on `Naked and Afraid' attempt to survive in a desolate, dangerous environment for 40 days - 19 more than they previously experienced on the show. Pushing the very limits of human endurance, the men and women must all vie for the same limited food, water and shelter while avoiding territorial-sensitive predators and venom-filled reptiles. Because there is no other choice, the competitors quickly get to know one another - and their surroundings - and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

Veteran survivalists familiar with the stripped-down drill after appearing on `Naked and Afraid' attempt to survive in a desolate, dangerous environment for 40 days - 19 more than they previously experienced on the show. Pushing the very limits of human endurance, the men and women must all vie for the same limited food, water and shelter while avoiding territorial-sensitive predators and venom-filled reptiles. Because there is no other choice, the competitors quickly get to know one another - and their surroundings - and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

The competition kicks off at Abbey House in Penrith, Cumbria, where Ian Sugden and his wife Sam treat their guests to an afternoon on the firing range and fancy bacon for breakfast.
Lisa Holloway prides herself on providing a home from home at Compton House in Newark, Nottinghamshire. But there are dusty discoveries, and Dave and Jo find the prices hard to swallow.
Dave and Jo Bate hope that their guests will embrace the pub vibe at The White Horse in Ripon, North Yorkshire. But Ed and Jane get locked in their room and it's 'tomatogate' at breakfast.
Former teachers Ed and Jane host at The Old Farmhouse in Cheshire. Some of their guests are surprised to be sharing a bathroom, and Sam and Ian are shocked by what's lurking under the bed.
The B&Bers meet for one last time to settle some scores and find out how much they've been paid. A heated exchange about cleaning leads to tears before the winner is announced.

Southampton. Tasha Whyte hopes to ease the tensions in the group with her simple menu and fun entertainment. But it's a dinner party full of twists and turns that ends with a bang. (Ep4/5)
Southampton. On the final night, vegetarian Bijal is on a mission to create the ultimate meat-free dinner party, in what proves to be an explosive end to the week. (Ep5/5)
The first visit is to The Swan Inn in Midhurst, West Sussex, run by Digby Furneaux. A sunny breakfast satisfies their guests, but Cleide feels rather exposed by the bathroom window.
Sunny and Faraah host at Osterley Park Hotel in Isleworth. Unfortunately, all of the guests complain about a cleaning catastrophe, and Digby checks out early.
Cleide Brook hosts at Plover Cottage in Huddersfield. The guests are amazed by the space, but Liz and Gary find more than they bargained for in their room, leading to some rude feedback.
The last visit is to The Forge Guest Rooms in Long Whatton, Leicestershire, run by Liz and Gary Scottorn. The guests love the luxury, but Cleide questions eating breakfast beside a hot tub.
The guests meet for the last time to find out how much they've been paid. Criticisms are laid bare as Digby reveals how much he paid for a room he didn't even spend the night in.
The Jersey Jaguar: Mike and Frank unleash a sleek 1967 Jaguar from a New Jersey garage and pick a general store with a presidential past.

Fabian ist am Boden zerstört, als er mit ansehen muss, wie sein Vater Roberto bei einer Explosion stirbt. Seine Familie ist bereits seit langer Zeit auf der Farm der Moores tätig. Doch sein Vater ist in einen Streit der Landbesitzer geraten.

Als zwei Jungs Opfer eines brutalen Angriffs werden, hat die Polizei mehrere Verdächtige im Blick. Es bedarf jedoch eindeutiger Beweise, um die Angreifer zu überführen. Das Opfer einer Entführung kann den Ermittlern wertvolle Hinweise geben.

Was anfangs wie ein Unfall aussieht, entpuppt sich nach eingehenden Untersuchungen als Verbrechen. Ein kleiner Junge wird nach einem Großbrand vermisst. Wenig später finden die Einsatzkräfte seine Leiche kilometerweit von seinem Zuhause entfernt.

Martin Dillon und Dr. Stephen Sher gehen oft gemeinsam auf die Jagd. Eines Tages stirbt Martin an einem Schuss. Sher behauptet, dass der Tod seines Freundes ein Unfall war. Da er ein angesehener Arzt ist, gibt es zunächst keinen Grund zu zweifeln.

Die Kassiererin einer Tankstelle wird bei einem bewaffneten Raubüberfall erschossen. Mithilfe eines Phantombilds sucht die Polizei den Täter. Die Polizei nutzt alle verfügbaren technischen Mittel, um den Mörder der neunjährigen Valerie zu finden.

Ein Molekulargenetiker unterstützt die Polizei bei ihren Ermittlungen in einem Mordfall in Arizona. Seine Ergebnisse liefern den Ermittlern einen wichtigen Beweis. Die Forensiker müssen ein abgetrenntes Bein untersuchen und das Opfer identifizieren.

Eine junge Frau verschwindet und wird nach wenigen Wochen tot aufgefunden. Spuren an ihrer Leiche deuten darauf hin, dass sie Opfer eines Raubmordes geworden ist. In ihrem Haus fehlen jedoch jegliche Spuren für ein gewaltsames Eindringen.

Bei einem Rollerderby zwischen den Minx und den Clobbers kommt es zu einer Rangelei, die für Rose Wilson tödlich endet. Da Rose als einzige einen Profivertrag in der Tasche hatte, erscheint den Ermittlern Eifersucht als mögliches Motiv. In Verdacht geraten einige ihrer Teamkolleginnen, doch dann stellt sich heraus, dass nicht die Tritte beim Rollerderby, sondern eine Überdosis des Schlankheitsmittels Dinitrophenol die Todesursache war.

Im Hope Memorial wird ein Hubschrauber gekapert, der eine Spenderleber transportieren soll. Dabei wird der Pilot schwer verletzt. Von der Leber fehlt allerdings jede Spur. Bei dem Toten handelt es sich um den Assistenzarzt Ryan Elliott. Kurz darauf wird der Tote jedoch als Sean Hovac identifiziert. Elliott gerät nun unter Verdacht, etwas mit dem Organraub zu tun zu haben.
